usage.outputShape: body.success (bool), body.textId (SMS id on success), body.quotaRemaining; on failure body.success=false + body.error
quirks: This /text endpoint SENDS an SMS to the supplied phone number - it is an outward, irreversible action.

Registry inputSchema is EMPTY/wrong (additionalProperties:false). The real required fields are phone (E.164, e.g. +15555550123) and message. Sending {} returns 200 with success:false and error 'Missing phone number parameter'.
EVERY call costs $0.02 and is charged even when it fails (the malformed empty-body call was still billed). Do not probe with empty bodies.
Response is HTTP 200 even on logical failure - you MUST check body.success, not the status code.
Each successful send decrements body.quotaRemaining (per-account SMS quota).
usage.guide: POST to the URL with a JSON body {phone, message} where phone is E.164 format (+countrycode...) and message is the SMS text. Payment is $0.02 USDC per call on Base via x402, charged even on malformed requests, so always send a valid phone + message. The response is HTTP 200 regardless of outcome - read body.success: true means the SMS was sent (body.textId is the message id), false means it failed (body.error explains why). This sends a real text message, so confirm the recipient before calling.
